title: Stop respecting screen sleep inhibition on the lock screen
line: Locking the screen now turns it off as configured even while a video or another app is keeping it awake.
explanation: On Wayland, browsers keep the screen awake while playing video through the idle-inhibit protocol, which KWin honours for every visible window (that's why minimizing the browser helped). PowerDevil already ignores D-Bus "keep screen on" requests while locked (since 2016), but KWin kept honouring Wayland idle inhibitors behind the lock screen, so the idle timeout that turns the screen off after locking never fired. KWin now drops idle inhibitors from all windows except the lock screen's own while the screen is locked, and re-evaluates them whenever the lock state changes.

commits.message:
idle_inhibition: ignore idle inhibitors while the screen is locked

A window inhibiting idle, like a browser playing a video, kept the
screen on behind the lock screen, where it can't be seen. Stop honoring
idle inhibitors while locked, except those of the lock screen itself.

BUG: 509688

media.caption: Locked with a window holding a Wayland idle inhibitor and "When locked: Immediately": the screen is still on 30 s later.
Same steps with the fix: PowerDevil turns the screen off right after locking.
